5055.html:
5055 chupáti 'touches' Dhātup. [√chup]
    Pa. chupati, Pk. chuvaï, N. chunu, A. soiba, B. chũyā, Or. chũibā, chõi°, Mth. chūyab, OAw. chuvaï, lakh. chūab, H. chūnā, G. chuvũ. — X *kṣubhati: S. chuhaṇu, P. chuhuṇā, chohṇā, WPah. cam. chūhṇā, bhiḍ. 1 sg. pret. chüiyũ < chupita-, OH. chuhnā. — X kṣipáti: Pk. chivaï 'touches'; Gy. eur. čiv- 'to throw, put', SEeur. čhiv- 'to throw'; Tir. 2 pl. imper. tsiya 'put'; Sh.     2. *sthānya-: WPah.kṭg. thā́n m. 'place, dwelling, police station'; Garh. thān 'place'.
    †sthānavant-.
